name: delay
description: Fixed delay line with feedback and a dry/wet mix.

params.name: delay_samples
params.doc: Delay length. 48000 samples = 1.0 s at 48 kHz.

params.name: feedback
params.doc: How much of the delayed signal is written back into the line. 0 = one repeat.

params.name: mix
params.doc: Dry/wet balance. 0 = dry only, 1.0 = delayed only.
